caption: The video captures an underwater view looking upward toward a lit surface, where cyan-blue water fills the frame and a concentrated glow sits at the top center. Several bright light shafts fan downward from that glow, separated by darker vertical bands that stretch through the middle of the scene. Along the upper edge, a rippling, caustic-like surface texture shifts its shape continuously from frame to frame. The configuration of the beams and the gaps between them tilts and reconfigures gradually rather than moving as a single rigid block. Faint horizontal light streaks in the lower portion drift and vary in brightness as the deeper blue fades below. Throughout the excerpt the central bright glow stays roughly fixed, keeping the overall composition stable while the shafts and ripples keep changing.
